title: ISO 8601-2:2019 Duration with Negative Support (Designator Format)
description: A duration in designator format with optional minus sign for reverse direction P[n]Y[n]M[n]DT[n]H[n]M[n]S or -P[n]Y[n]M[n]DT[n]H[n]M[n]S (§4.4.1.9)
$comment: ISO 8601 permits omitting any zero-valued component (at least one must remain), allows a decimal fraction on the lowest-order component only, and accepts both comma and full stop as the decimal sign. The extension adds an optional leading minus sign and the week form

anyOf.$comment: Week durations, signed like the rest of the extension
